## ISSUES
### HOUSING AFFORDABILTY
1. Advance implementation of the housing elements to increase the production of affordable housing.
2. Promote first time homebuyers loan program and identify future funding sources for its continued success.
3. Proactively identify and facilitate opportunities to attract multi-family housing development on key sites.
### FISCAL SUSTAINBILTY
Advance economic development strategies that diversify and strengthens the city’s tax base.
Identify and pursue new ongoing revenue sources to support long term fiscal stability.
Update and regular evaluate fees to balance cost recovery with community access to program and service.
PUBLIC SAFETY, HEALTH & WELFARE
Maintain adequate public safety staffing resources to provide for the needs of the community.
Strengthen and enhance resources to protect homes and emergency preparedness.
Increase investment in police technologies that aid in crime prevention and rapid response.
### DUBLIN DOWNTOWN
Revitalize Downtown Dublin – Make downtown the vibrant heart of our city with more local businesses, restaurants, gathering spaces, and community events. Although after years of hearing from the community about the need to create downtown, on November 5, 2019 the city council unanimously approved the downtown Dublin preferred vision however the project is still not moved since 2019 and stuck at designing phase. I will make sure Dublin’s preferred vision moves forward and reaches its final stage.
Continue to plan for targeted city investment to catalyze development in downtown.
LEGAL EDUCATION
A Legal Education & Investment Background
My legal education and investment background help me examine complex issues carefully, understand their legal implications, and make informed decisions. On the City Council, I would bring that perspective to decisions involving development, contracts, regulations, and the responsible use of taxpayer dollars.
THREE REASONS TO VOTE FOR TEJPREET SINGH
AN IMMIGRANT WHO UNDERSTANDS THE JOURNEY
I came to this country as an immigrant and worked to build a career, establish a home, and raise a family. I understand firsthand many of the challenges immigrant families face while building their lives and becoming part of their communities.
A FATHER WHO UNDERSTANDS THE COST OF RAISING A FAMILY
As a father of two, I understand the everyday pressures families face from housing and childcare to transportation and the rising cost of living. Dublin is a wonderful place to call home, but keeping it livable and accessible for families requires thoughtful local leadership.
